title: C2PO: Diagnosing and Disentangling Bias Shortcuts in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using multiple-choice stereotype association tests (BBQ, StereoSet), measuring probability differences in under-specified questions (UnQover), and testing resilience against occupational gender stereotypes in coreference resolution (WinoBias).
